findings.problem: The hint 'the trip back; de ... = back' also fits el regreso (estar de regreso is very common in Latin America) and el retorno, so more than one answer is right.
findings.fix: hint: the trip back, as in a round trip (ida y ...); de ... = back; same word as a lap or spin

back.es: return, way back (also turn, lap, stroll); de vuelta = back

note: The trick works through volver rather than an English sound-alike, which is weak but not false, since vuelta comes from volver.
